label: Begun-or-homogeneous coverage controls: omissions and strictness on integer times
paraphrase: Closed controls on interpretations with one world, integer times and two individuals, false alone with received esse; statements about these interpretations only. (1) Eternal history (both present at every moment), a supplied fact marks false at moment 0, no giving: concurrent actualization for begun things and for homogeneous things both hold, since false has no first moment and is not homogeneous; the begun-or-homogeneous coverage and weak concurrent actualization 40a97664 fail. (2) Eternal history, no supplied facts, no giving: the begun restriction and the coverage (false is homogeneous) hold; the homogeneous restriction and 40a97664 fail. (3) Begun history (false present from moment 0 on), no supplied facts, true gives false being at moment 0 only: the homogeneous restriction and the coverage (false begins at 0) hold; the begun restriction and 40a97664 fail. (4) Eternal history, moment 0 marked, true gives false being at every moment: 40a97664 holds and the coverage fails.
